title: Diddy - The Mind Is Powerful [V17]
description: Collaboration between Kanye, Diddy, 88-Keys, and Bruno Mars announced on 88's Instagram May 21st, 2015. Kanye also asked Tyler, The Creator to shoot a music video for it. Has Diddy's adlibs and Bruno Mars singing the hook. Interestingly, Kanye had the idea to feature Bruno on the song back in February 2015, but it's possible he never recorded as he may have been featured on later bounces if he had. Originally thought to have been called "Shit's Ugly!" due to the caption, before it was revealed to be this song. Curiously, Focus..., who works frequently with Dr. Dre, commented on the post "Um... i beg to differ general @eightyocho", indicating he knew something to the contrary of 88's announcement of the song. This lines up with 88-Keys' claim that this song was intended to be a Diddy single, but was later replaced by the song "Finna Get Loose". According to Egg, Bruno Mars never recorded, so this version may use THE-DREAM's vocals instead as a reference for him.

description:
After changing the name of his 7th solo album from So Help Me God to SWISH, Kanye began to develop all new songs throughout mid-late 2015 meant for the album, with most of them eventually making it onto the final release of The Life Of Pablo. Kanye also continued to work on many So Help Me God and Yeezus 2 tracks, but by the end of 2015 and the start of 2016, Kanye had dropped most of these tracks from the tracklist for SWISH, which began to resemble the final The Life Of Pablo tracklist strongly.

(05/03/2015) (Kanye announces the title change to SWISH)
(12/31/2015) (Kanye drops "Facts," and the rollout begins)

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Synth Reflective' was designed by Kanye West for June 2019's batch of regional-exclusive releases. The 350 V2 began its legacy in 2016, when it was first seen on the runway at the Yeezy Season 3 fashion show. This model incorporates a Primeknit upper, ditching the heel tab once synonymous with the design. When hit with direct light, the shoe reveals powerful reflective detailing on the upper and laces. Full-length adidas Boost cushioning is reinforced by a rubber midsole/outsole.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 is iconic and highly coveted for its minimalist construction and reinvented heritage technology. Issued in September 2019, this edition benefits from a breathable Citrin Primeknit bootie styled with asymmetrical reflectivity, a see-through lateral stripe and Three-Stripes branding applied to the inner heel. A semi-translucent midsole carrying Boost tech and a gum rubber outsole form the underfoot.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 ADULTS
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘Israfil’ features a patchwork-like composition on the Primeknit upper, constructed from a two-tone blend of tan and grey yarns. The neutral hues are enlivened by a streak of yellow on the signature post-dyed monofilament side stripe. Responsive cushioning comes courtesy of the standard full-length Boost midsole, encased in a semi-translucent rubber sidewall. A grippy gum rubber outsole provides durable traction underfoot.

title: YEEZY SLIDE
description: The adidas Yeezy Slide ‘Core’ showcases a monochromatic light brown hue throughout the exterior of the futuristic sandal, featuring open-toe construction on a cushy EVA foam build. Branding is limited to adidas’ three-stripe logo stamped on the footbed and a Yeezy wordmark on the lining of the upper. Underfoot, the outsole is treated to a series of deep horizontal grooves for soft cushioning and enhanced traction.
